01

The Arrival

I landed in Toronto with a suitcase, a student visa, and a plan nobody else could see. No family money behind me. No one to fall back on. When you start at zero, every dollar has a job and every decision counts. That pressure became my greatest teacher.

When you start at zero, every dollar has a job.
Early days in Canada
02

The Build

I studied at Humber College in Toronto, worked my way into tech, and became a software engineer. A salary gave me stability, but I learned fast that a salary alone does not build freedom. So I started learning how money actually grows: one book, one video, one small investment at a time. I made mistakes. I learned rules. I kept going.

A salary gives stability. Investing builds freedom.
The Build — Humber grad
Learn daily.

One book, one video, one small investment at a time. Small reps, every day.

Make mistakes. Keep rules.

I made mistakes. I learned rules. I kept going — that is the whole system.

Salary → System.

Stability from work. Growth from a system I follow every single day.

03

The Wealth

Today I have $700K invested, built dollar by dollar from my own work. No trust fund. No inheritance. No shortcuts. Just discipline, patience, and a system I follow every single day. And I am not done. This is still the middle of the story, not the end.

No trust fund. No inheritance. Just discipline.
Today
04

Why I post every day

Most investing content is made by gurus selling dreams. I am an engineer with a day job, building in public, sharing one stock story a day in plain words with real numbers. If an immigrant who started with nothing can build this, you can build from wherever you are. Follow the journey. Learn the rules. Build your own.

If I could build from nothing, you can build from wherever you are.
